jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Turn sales and finance data into dashboards and reports that teams use every week. You will write SQL, automate recurring reports in Python, and build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau. Two years of analytics experience and a degree in statistics, mathematics or computer science are required. Experience with dbt or Airflow is a plus.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Python)
jobs.description: Design and run the APIs behind our products. You will build services with Python and FastAPI or Django, model data in PostgreSQL and design clean REST APIs. We ask for three years of backend experience and a computer science degree. Docker and AWS experience is preferred.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern
jobs.description: Six-month internship building and evaluating models for customer data. You need Python, pandas and scikit-learn, and should be studying for a bachelor's degree. PyTorch or NLP project work is a bonus.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (React)
jobs.description: Build the screens our customers use every day. You will write React and TypeScript, keep our CSS and component library consistent, and test what you ship. Two years of frontend experience and a degree in computer science or IT are required. Next.js and Testing Library experience help.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Keep our services fast, safe and boring to deploy. You will run Linux servers and Kubernetes clusters, package services with Docker and own the CI/CD pipelines. Three years of experience are required; Terraform and AWS experience are preferred, and an AWS certification is valued.

certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Build the pipelines that feed our analytics and machine learning. You will write Python and SQL, run Apache Spark jobs and orchestrate them with Airflow. Three years of data engineering experience and an engineering or computer science degree are required. Kafka and dbt are a plus.

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Make releases safe by automating our web and API tests. You will write end-to-end tests with Selenium or Playwright in Python or Java, test REST APIs, and run the suites in CI/CD. Two years of experience and an ISTQB certification are expected; load testing with JMeter is a plus.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Own the roadmap for our small-business payments product. You will run user research, size opportunities with SQL and keep sales, support and engineering aligned. Four years of product experience and a bachelor's degree are required. A/B testing and Jira experience are a plus.

jobs.title: UX/UI Designer
jobs.description: A twelve-month contract to redesign our booking experience. You will run user research, prototype in Figma and grow our design system. Two years of product design experience and a degree in design or human-computer interaction are required. Accessibility knowledge and some HTML and CSS are a plus.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: Grow traffic and sign-ups for our home products brand. You will own SEO, run Google Ads campaigns, report in Google Analytics and plan content. Two years of digital marketing experience and a Google Ads certification are required. HubSpot and email marketing experience are a plus.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description: Start conversations with businesses that need our software. You will prospect B2B accounts, make cold calls and keep every lead up to date in the CRM. One year in a sales or customer-facing role is required. SaaS sales and LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience help.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description: Help leadership plan and track the business. You will build financial models in Excel, prepare monthly variance analysis and support budgeting. Two years of finance experience and a degree in commerce, finance or economics are required; CFA Level 1 is valued. Power BI and SAP are a plus.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description: Hire the people who build our company. You will run recruitment end to end, source candidates, interview them and keep the applicant tracking system tidy. Two years of recruitment experience are required. Employer branding and HR analytics experience are a plus.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description: Part-time, four hours a day. Answer customer questions by email and chat, solve problems in our ticketing tool and write help articles. You need clear written English and experience with Zendesk or Freshdesk. Basic SQL and Hindi are a plus.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Analyst
jobs.description: A six-month contract to improve stock planning across our warehouses. You will forecast demand, plan inventory and analyse it in Excel and SQL. Two years of experience and an engineering or supply chain degree are required. SAP and Power BI are a plus.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
jobs.description: Protect our customers and systems. You will monitor alerts in our SIEM, respond to incidents and review network security controls. Two years of security operations experience, a computer science degree and CompTIA Security+ are required. Python scripting and cloud security are a plus.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Build models that predict which customers will buy, stay or leave. You will explore data in Python and SQL, train and evaluate models with scikit-learn or PyTorch, and explain results to product teams. We ask for three years of data science experience and a master's degree in statistics, computer science or a related field. Experience with experimentation and MLOps tools such as MLflow is a plus.
